notes.title: New Game Announcement: Pigeon Protocol
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our latest free to play game, Pigeon Protocol! Releasing 21/04/2023, wishlist it now!

[b]The base game will be Free-To-Play! so give it a try with your friends and let us know how you find it![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404247/a657ad22107d9fcd4a937936f7cab31de88ff01d.png[/img]

Store Page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327660/Pigeon_Protocol/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327660/Pigeon_Protocol/[/url]

[h3]Description[/h3]
Play with up to 30 of your friends in this frantic bird based online game! Customize your pigeon, Compete to build nests, own territory and to keep hold of shiny things. But watch out, its a bird eat bird world out there! 

[b]There will also be a founders bundle that includes both the Soundtrack and some additional hats for your bird If you do want to financially support us and the game![/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 now live!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who played our game and provided feedback! This update should resolve the main outstanding graphical and performance issues people have encountered.

[h3]Change Log:[/h3]
- Fixed bug where game would default to "Super Grunge" setting
- Settings Menu now saves configurations more appropriately
- Added target frame rate options and the ability to toggle vsync on and/or off in game
- Game now defaults to locked target frame rate 60 (this can be changed in the options from the pause menu)

~ Bronze Box Interactive Team

notes.title: Final patch for Batho[tel] and price drop!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Firstly, John and I would like to thank everyone who's played Batho[tel] over the past year or so.
This was a first project for us where we learned a lot and have had a great time interacting with you guys (especially all the art people have made using our notebook mechanic).

We wanted to make a post to let you know that we're going to be making one last patch for Batho[tel] before we consider it finished. This patch will work on final bug fixes for the game (including that annoying, but very motivated resolution bug upon death).
We had a great time working on this game,  we're very proud of the work we've done but we're equally excited to put our full effort and attention on other projects.

Lastly, we have decided to reduce the price of Batho[tel] from £3.99 to £1.69 ($4.99 to $1.99).
We have decided to do this for multiple reasons. The first is that with this last patch, support for Batho[tel] will be officially over. The second is since the pricing of Batho[tel], the economy has changed in such a way that our old pricing doesn't fit with what we consider reflective of the content.
To everyone who paid the original price for Batho[tel], we appreciate you taking a chance on our game and your feedback has helped us in many ways.

When we have something new to share from Bronze Box Interactive, you guys will be the first to know.

Best Wishes,

-Mylo and John.
